forecast_obs_notes: NWP models show tight agreement: ECMWF 84.4°F, HRRR 84.8°F, and NBM 83.9°F all cluster in the 84–85°F range, slightly below the NWS official high of ~86°F. max_temp_prediction: The NWP model consensus of ~84–85°F is the most defensible estimate. If skies partially clear by midday as NWS suggests, 85–86°F is achievable, but confidence is moderate-low; the balance of evidence favors landing just under the NWS headline near 85°F.
